units.displayText: Hang in there, Mr. Robot! I'll save you with my magic!

spans.text: Hang in there, Mr. Robot! I'll save you with my magic!

units.rawText: Just then, a cry and a faint glow comes from atop the city wall.
units.displayText: Just then, a cry and a faint glow comes from atop the city wall.

spans.text: Just then, a cry and a faint glow comes from atop the city wall.

units.rawText: Take this! High-Pressure Water Hose Attack—
units.displayText: Take this! High-Pressure Water Hose Attack—

spans.text: Take this! High-Pressure Water Hose Attack—

units.rawText: How does a high-pressure hose count as magic!?
units.displayText: How does a high-pressure hose count as magic!?

spans.text: How does a high-pressure hose count as magic!?

units.rawText: Countless little bubbles stream out as a cloud, pouring toward Aegis.
units.displayText: Countless little bubbles stream out as a cloud, pouring toward Aegis.

spans.text: Countless little bubbles stream out as a cloud, pouring toward Aegis.

units.rawText: Now, catch these bubbles with your body! Let's go—
